header: Certificates a buyer's procurement office can check
lead: Each seal links to the register of the body that issued it. If the register says something different from this page, the register is right.
note: All four certificates are held by Larkmoor for the hosted service. They do not cover installations you run on your own hardware, and they do not cover our implementation partners, who certify separately.

certificates.title: Data protection audit, level B — Office for Business Software, valid to 2027
Security audit for stock systems — Institute for Operational Safety, valid to 2026
Accessibility review, level AA — Office for Digital Accessibility, 2025
Invoicing seal for trade — Chamber Testing Board, renewed annually
